comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This item's recipe appears at Candia from Craftsman but only if you have equipped either the Adept of Ages (Mythical Era) title or an Age effect (Mythical Era) EX Effect item. Recipe:

Skill/Rank: Sewing R7
Ingredients: Woad x3, Cotton fabric x10, Gold thread x5

Stats:

+1 Dye trading
8000 fame to equip, female-only, Blue/Black/Purple. Different from the Dungeon drop and Item Shop versions which cannot be color-customized.

Source/pics: rabbilog.blog46.fc2.com/blog-entry-298.html

Cheers.
